messages:
Maya Chen: Quick ask — I need short-lived admin (db-admin) to rotate the SSO service account keys for prod-redis-1/2. Planning a 2h window tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT. Can someone approve or flag any logging/redaction concerns?
Samir Patel: I can greenlight the window, but want to ensure no plaintext tokens end up in logs. @Linda Rowe can you confirm redaction behavior for the rotate script?
Linda Rowe: Prefer a break-glass ephemeral-admin grant. ACL audit will capture ops. Confirm you’ll use the approved rotate script and the `--sensitive-mask` option. Also drop the exact command & runbook link here.
Maya Chen: Plan is:
```
./scripts/rotate_redis_keys.sh --clusters prod-redis-1,prod-redis-2 \n  --mode apply --sensitive-mask --notify-on-success
```
Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/redis-rotation-2026 (will attach PR and checklist). I expect the script to print truncated key IDs but not full tokens; still want to be safe about logs. I’ll export the audit logs after.
Alex Gomez: Oncall will approve once Linda signs off on redaction. @ops-bot can you raise the break-glass request and set duration to 2h for maya.chen?
ops-bot: break-glass request created: BG-2026-827. Requestor: Maya Chen. Duration: 2h. Pending approver: Linda Rowe. Audit: enabled. To approve run: `/bg approve BG-2026-827`
Linda Rowe: Approved. Please run strictly in the window and post the minimal audit snippet to #eng-security-audit (not a public channel). Scrub any base64 blobs and redact token-like strings before posting. :lock:
Maya Chen: Thanks — will run at 10:01 PT and paste only the summarized audit (timestamp, op, actor, truncated IDs). Will ping here if any issue. :thumbsup:
